# Tamanna's Hut

> Tamanna's Hut is an Indian ecommerce store for baby and children's clothing, including girlswear, boyswear, coordinated sets, and new arrivals.

## Primary pages

- [Storefront](https://www.tamannashut.com/): Featured collections and new products.
- [Shop](https://www.tamannashut.com/shop): Search, filter, and browse all active products.
- [Girls](https://www.tamannashut.com/shop?category=girls): Girlswear catalogue.
- [Boys](https://www.tamannashut.com/shop?category=boys): Boyswear catalogue.
- [New arrivals](https://www.tamannashut.com/shop?category=new-arrivals): Recently published products.
- [Contact](https://www.tamannashut.com/contact): Customer-support information.
- [Shipping policy](https://www.tamannashut.com/shipping-policy): Delivery information.
- [Return policy](https://www.tamannashut.com/return-policy): Return and refund conditions.

## Shopping guidance

Product pages provide images, available colours, sizes, stock, price, reviews, and related products. Customers must sign in before checkout. Payment and account actions require explicit customer confirmation.
